settings_signin_sso: You sign in as {#em}{email}{/em} with single sign-on. To also have a password, ask an admin for a password link.
settings_profile_description: How you appear to others on this instance
settings_profile_name_hint: Optional — when empty you go by your email prefix.
settings_email_description: You sign in as {#em}{email}{/em}. Changing it takes effect immediately.
settings_email_taken: That email is already in use
settings_password_description: Changing it signs you out everywhere else.
settings_password_changed: Password changed — other sessions are signed out
settings_sessions_description: Devices currently signed in to your account
settings_appearance_language_hint: Translates Settings and the drawing canvas
settings_danger_description: Irreversible. Everything you own goes with the account.
settings_danger_description_team: Irreversible. Your private work goes with the account. Team drawings stay.
settings_danger_delete_hint: Permanently delete your account and all of your drawings and folders.
settings_danger_delete_hint_team: Permanently delete your account and all of your private drawings and folders.
settings_danger_sole_admin: You're the instance's only admin. Promote another member to admin before deleting your account.
settings_danger_counts_failed: Couldn't load your content counts. Close this dialog and try again.
settings_danger_confirm_loading: This will delete your account and permanently delete all of your content. This can't be undone.
settings_danger_confirm_contents: This will delete your account and permanently delete your {contents}.
settings_danger_confirm_empty: This will delete your account. You have no drawings or folders.
settings_danger_confirm_empty_team: This will delete your account. You have no private drawings or folders.

match.countPlural=one: Your {count} Team drawing stays with the team.

settings_import_description_admin: Bring scenes and images over. Shared collections become folders in Team, and your private scenes go to Private.
settings_import_description_member: Bring your private scenes and images over. They go to Private. An admin imports the shared collections.
settings_import_key_hint_create: Create one in Excalidraw+ under workspace settings ({#link}how{/link}).
settings_import_key_hint_admin: A personal key (starts with uk-) also brings your private scenes.
settings_import_key_hint_member: Use a personal key (starts with uk-).
settings_import_key_hint_access: Read access is enough. The key is used for this import only and is not saved.
settings_import_workspace_key: This is a workspace key, so your private scenes are not included. Use a personal key to bring them too.

settings_import_files_description: Add .excalidraw files from your computer. They go to Private. PNG and SVG exports that include the scene work too. To put files in a folder or in Team, open it and drop them on the drawings, or drop them on it in the sidebar.
settings_import_files_drop: Drop files here, or click to choose
settings_tokens_description: Connect an AI client such as Claude Code over MCP. A token sees what you see and can create and trash drawings as you.
settings_tokens_copy_description: You won't see it again. Anyone with it can read your drawings and create new ones as you, until you revoke it.
settings_tokens_new_description: Name it after the client or device that will use it.
settings_apps_description: Apps you signed in to Excaliself, such as a Claude.ai connector. They have the same access as a token.
settings_invites_description: Single-use links that add a member. Each expires after 7 days — copy a pending link to send it again.
settings_members_last_admin: The last admin can't be demoted.
settings_members_reset_copied: Reset link copied — single-use, valid for 24 hours
settings_members_reset_copy_failed: Couldn't copy the reset link — generate it again
settings_members_counts_failed: Couldn't load {name}'s content counts. Close this dialog and try again.
settings_members_confirm_loading: This will delete {name}'s account and permanently delete all of their content. This can't be undone.
settings_members_confirm_contents: This will delete {name}'s account and permanently delete their {contents}.
settings_members_confirm_empty: This will delete {name}'s account. They have no drawings or folders.
settings_members_confirm_empty_team: This will delete {name}'s account. They have no private drawings or folders.

match.countPlural=one: Their {count} Team drawing stays with the team.

settings_sessions_sign_out_others_failed: Couldn't sign out all other sessions
